verdict.rationale: Missive documents connecting Gmail, Outlook, Exchange, iCloud and IMAP accounts, with full two-way sync for Gmail, and its address books sync with Office 365 and Google. Together these let a switcher bring existing mail and contacts in through account sync. The docs never say how much mail history is fetched, and they describe no import from a desktop client or from files. Missing for 10: confirmation that the complete mail history is synced or imported, import from old clients or files (e.g. mbox/PST/vCard), contact import beyond Office 365/Google sync, and hands-on corroboration of migration.

support.subject: As a switcher, I can import my complete mail history and contacts from my old provider or client

citations.quote: Connect Gmail, Outlook, Exchange, iCloud, or IMAP email accounts to Missive.
Connect Gmail or Google Workspace to Missive. Full two-way sync with labels.
Manage your contacts in shared or private address books.
